question: What is each cell of the calibration table held to: for every family and probe, from which size, and within what of which value?
rule: The table holds every family to what the table's known-answers criterion holds it to, as its passing judged reading on the table measured whole on build 801 found it (`holds`): the 23 families the old seed held to the bands and sizes they were held to since 2026-11-12, A4 and D4 to the 4D lattice's bands from the size their own cells read on every seed through the largest. At a ladder size N of at least a probe's `from_nodes`, the mean over the cell's seeds must lie within the `within` of the last band at most N, of `theory`, and the probe must read on the share of seeds the table has always asked (`calibration/deviation.AVAILABILITY_FLOOR`); under it the cell is measured and shown and gates nothing. A family without a dimension must be given no value by any of the four probes on any seed from 4,096 nodes. The spread of a cell's seeds gates nothing (the operator, 2026-11-12 11:14). No tolerance and no size is typed by hand: `tools/table_rule.py --write` makes `table_holds.json`, and it refuses a judged reading that does not pass.
